# Prompt gallery

<!-- generated by tools/playbook_build.py from playbook/prompts.json and playbook/styles: do not edit by hand -->

[简体中文 README](../README.zh-CN.md) · [README](../README.md) · [the styles](../playbook/README.md#styles) · [catalog: Styles and Films tabs](https://anveai.github.io/motion-pack/catalog/)

**29 copy-ready prompts**, one per format and style pair. Paste one into Claude Code (or any agent with the motion-pack skill), swap `<your product>` for yours, and the agent runs `mp brief` → `mp plan --style` → render → `mp lint`.

**Tested** means: CI checks that `mp brief` routes each prompt to its format with a clear lead and that `mp plan <format> --style <id>` builds its plan (`tools/playbook_build.py --check`, `tools/tests/test_styles.py`). The preview next to each prompt is that style's demo (a hero style: its 13.5 s scene made with `templates/style-scene`; a starter skin: a 10 s `ad` on a placeholder subject), not a film made from that exact prompt. The same prompt makes a different film on every run.

## Character spot (wordless, one gag, one feature) (`character-spot`)

A wordless cartoon or mime spot: one situation, one product benefit, at most 6 emotions on a neutral stage, a twist on a smash, a reaction hold, one end line.

### Character spot × Paper Cut (hero scene), 13.5 s 16:9

```text
Make a 14-second 16:9 wordless character spot in the Paper Cut style: a cut-paper night room with layered planes, a figure taps a lamp on, page-peel cuts, then the title <your product>. Folk pluck bed.
```

## Ad (15 s / 30 s, paid or organic) (`ad`)

A direct-response or brand ad for feeds and pre-roll: value inside 3 s, the brand inside the action by 5-7 s, one product moment, one proof, a CTA end card.

### Ad × Blueprint, 10 s 16:9

```text
Make a 10-second 16:9 ad for <your product> in the Blueprint style: a hook line, the problem, the product reveal, one proof line and an end card with the name and a CTA. Music and sound. Then lint it.
```

## Launch film (hero) (`launch-film`)

A product or release gets one hero film: a stake or claim, one turn, the product acting, one sourced proof, the name, the URL. Type-led or VO-led; a founder on camera is a variant (see exemplars).

### Launch film × Chrome Product, 35 s 16:9

```text
Make a 35-second 16:9 launch film introducing <your product> in the Chrome Product style: a pain on frame 0, the reveal on a cinematic hit, three features, sourced proof and an end card. Then draft the X post.
```

## Explainer (question, wrong model, reframe, proof, so-what) (`explainer`)

How something works or why it matters: one idea, one diagram built step by step, a voice or type leading, one real example.

## The style prompts

Each style also has its own prompt (`mp styles <id>` prints it, with the Chinese version under `--zh`):

| style | prompt |
|---|---|
| `blueprint` | Blueprint style: mono type on drafting blue, pale blue-white ink and one signal yellow, fine ruled lines, outline-then-fill and typewriter type, slices and mask reveals, a tech pulse bed with pen clicks and a scan sweep. |
| `chrome-product` | Chrome product style: graphite stage, silver-white type with an ice-blue accent, a brushed-metal sheen and one star glint, tracking that collapses, zoom-through and luma-wipe transitions, a cinematic drone with a light sweep and a metallic hit. |
| `documentary-grain` | Documentary grain style: observational 16 mm at night, handheld drift that settles, rack focus from the lamp to the book to the face, a mono lower third, a typed archival card, film gate and grain, dips to black, ambient bed. |
| `editorial-print` | Editorial print style: serif headlines on warm newsprint, near-black ink and one red accent, a light halftone and paper tooth, mask-rise type, calm wipes and pushes, a marimba bed with paper flips. No glow, no neon. |
| `kinetic-poster` | Kinetic poster style: giant heavy black type slammed onto signal yellow, one cobalt accent, scale-slam and weight-morph type with a small overshoot, whip and scale-punch transitions, a hype house bed with punches and a kick on every card. |
| `neon-night` | Neon night style: the scene through rain running down glass, magenta and cyan rim light, passing light streaks, a slow push-in on every shot, heavy bloom on the practicals, light-leak cuts, a synthwave bed over the rain. |
| `paper-cut` | Paper cut style: a cut-paper diorama of layered planes at real depths, crisp drop shadows from one front key, boil on twelves and animation on 12s, page-peel cuts, kraft colours with fibre, a folk pluck bed with paper sounds. |
| `retro-crt` | Retro CRT style: phosphor-green mono type on black, one amber accent, scanlines with a light tape wobble and glow, glitch-split and typewriter type, static and glitch cuts, a chiptune bed with key clicks and a glitch stutter. |
| `soft-clay` | Soft clay style: a stop-motion clay world animated on 2s, squash and stretch on every tap and landing, a soft moonlight key and a warm lamp pool, lilac set, plum ink, hard cuts, a lo-fi bed with pops and a boing. |
| `swiss-grid` | Swiss grid style: heavy black sans on pure white, one signal red for the key word, flush-left lines, letters that rise crisp, hard cuts and straight pushes on the beat, a clean tech pulse bed with ticks. No textures. |
